name: CPD-1
summary: CPD-1 (LS-193743) is a drug with a benzofuranyl piperazine structure, which acts as a potent and selective agonist for the 5-HT2 receptor family, with highest affinity and full agonist efficacy at the 5-HT2C subtype, and lower affinity and partial agonist action at the 5-HT2A and 5-HT2B subtypes.

pharmacology.text: CPD-1 (LS-193743) is a drug with a benzofuranyl piperazine structure, which acts as a potent and selective agonist for the 5-HT2 receptor family, with highest affinity and full agonist efficacy at the 5-HT2C subtype, and lower affinity and partial agonist action at the 5-HT2A and 5-HT2B subtypes.
pharmacology.kind: Serotonin 5-HT2 receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist

uses.en: It is a research compound used to study 5-HT2 serotonin receptors. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是用於研究 5-HT2 血清素受體的研究化合物，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是用于研究 5-HT2 血清素受体的研究化合物，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: Drugs that mainly activate the 5-HT2C receptor, as CPD-1 does, tend to reduce appetite. The diet drug lorcaserin worked this way.
fact.zh: 像 CPD-1 這樣主要活化 5-HT2C 受體的藥物，通常會降低食慾，減肥藥氯卡色林就是以這種方式作用。
fact.zhHans: 像 CPD-1 这样主要活化 5-HT2C 受体的药物，通常会降低食欲，减肥药氯卡色林就是以这种方式作用。
